records.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for setting up Ridge Analytics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project and no key milestone despite 1 invite and three nudges (email:cddb1bcd, email:5d40b033). Ana replied warmly but non-committally -- "might take you up on a walkthrough at some point" (email:700814cf) -- and her only concrete need is SSO, which is blocked on an open ticket (tick_c34522470979). Low unaided momentum in 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Glad things are going well -- and a walkthrough whenever you're ready sounds good.

On your open ticket about SSO: SSO is available on the Team plan, and Tariq is still following up with you there.

In the meantime, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team's work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Want me to grab 20 minutes with you this week to set that first project up together?

Best,
Priya
